help.blenderSummary: Can't see the animations in Blender?
help.blenderIntro: The animations (idle, walk, run, jump, wave) are already inside the .glb: Blender imports them as Actions, but doesn't assign one automatically, so the timeline looks empty. To see them:
help.blenderStep1: Select the Armature in the outliner.
help.blenderStep2: Open a Dope Sheet editor and switch to Action Editor mode.
help.blenderStep3: Click the Browse Action menu (the icon to the left of the name) and choose walk / run / etc.
help.blenderAlt: Alternatively use the Nonlinear Animation (NLA) editor: there you'll find all the actions ready to drag.
